Video.summary: “He loves me. He loves me not.” Wouldn’t it be great if there was a formula to get your partner to commit? Josie has been dating Curry for more than three years, and she says she’s ready to dump him if he doesn’t pop the question soon. Curry says he loves his girlfriend, so why is he afraid to walk down the aisle? Will Josie hold out for a ring, or will she kick this commitment-phobe to the curb? Then, Melissa thought she had it all –- the ring, the dress and the man of her dreams –- until she discovered her wedding was a sham. She says her husband, John, lied about how many times he’d been married, but the biggest tale of all is that he’s still married to another woman! John admits that he lied about being divorced, but says Melissa wouldn’t have stayed with him if he told her the truth. Will Melissa ever be able to trust him again ... and should she? Plus, meet a couple who says their dream wedding turned into a nightmare when the wedding planner scammed them out of $30,000.
Video.title: Commit Or Quit

Video.summary: Terrell Owens is a six-time NFL pro-bowler and arguably one of the best wide receivers to play the game, but he may be better known for his antics off the field. His tumultuous career has been well-documented, and he's been called arrogant, toxic and friendless. The football great sits down with Dr. Phil to set the record straight about the bad rap he says he’s been getting, especially from the mothers of three of his children, who claim he's also a deadbeat dad who is behind on child support payments and makes little attempt to see his kids. What does Terrell think of their accusations? See what happens when the moms come together to confront the alleged absentee dad on Dr. Phil's stage about missed birthday parties, ignored phone calls and empty promises. Is Terrell living in the lap of luxury while his kids go without? What kind of relationship does he want with his children? Dr. Phil delves into Terrell's past to help him create a better future for his children. Plus, at 38, will he play in the NFL again?
Video.title: A Football Star’s Daddy Drama

Video.summary: Is there someone in your life you just can’t stand? Wouldn’t life be easier if you could find a way to make peace? Dr. Phil speaks with people who often struggle to get along: the ex-wife and the stepmom. Jennifer and her ex-husband’s new wife, Carol, hated each other for two years, until one pivotal moment changed their relationship forever. Together, they wrote the book No One’s the Bitch, and offer the 10 steps to strengthening the stepfamily -- starting with the women. Then, Lori says she's had a tense and rocky relationship with her husband’s ex-wife, Stephanie, and says the past eight years have been difficult. Can Dr. Phil get these two women to negotiate a new relationship? Just what are the boundaries for a stepmother? There are 1,300 stepfamilies forming every day in the U.S. Learn what you can do to ensure a happy and healthy family.
Video.title: How To Get Along With Anyone

Video.title: The Doctor, The Wife, The Mistress

Video.summary: Is compulsive spending ruining your life? According to a recent Gallup poll, the average American owes $29,000 in credit card debt, and last year, 1.6 million U.S. households filed for bankruptcy. Dr. Phil has advice for avoiding credit card catastrophes this holiday season.
Video.title: Where'd The Money Go?

Video.summary: It’s been more than two months since a young mother of two, Susan Powell, vanished without a trace. Susan’s husband, Josh, is now a person of interest in this case but her family claims he refuses to cooperate with police. Dr. Phil speaks with the missing woman's parents, Chuck and Judy. Learn what they have to say about what they conclude is odd behavior of Susan’s husband and why say they fear for their grandchildren. A Dr. Phil field producer travels to the camp area where Josh allegedly took his sons after midnight the night Susan disappeared. Don’t miss what she discovers! And, legal analyst Lisa Bloom weighs in on this case. Next, Ed Smart, whose daughter, Elizabeth, was kidnapped and found, knows what it’s like to be a person of interest like Josh. Hear what he says. Plus, a father whose daughter, Kimberly Medina, has been missing for 14 years shares the mistakes he thinks he’s made and has a strong message for Chuck and Judy about their grandchildren. Go behind the headlines in this heartbreaking story.
Video.title: The Disappearance of Susan Powell

Video.summary: The exclusive interview with the Ukrainian orphan who is making headlines. Is she the real life version of “The Orphan”? Natalia’s adoptive parents have been accused of abandoning her when she was just 8 years old. But they claim Natalia, who has a form of dwarfism, is really a sociopathic adult posing as a child -- who tried to kill them. Natalia speaks out for the first time to Dr. Phil.
Video.title: Natalia Grace’s Exclusive Interview

Video.summary: Laurie says her dad, John, is in “total denial” about being an absolutely terrible hoarder. She says every room in the house is piled to the ceiling with “junk,” including the garage, where she claims she once found a “mummified kitten!” To top it off, Laurie claims the downstairs has a horrible bed bug infestation! John says his daughter is just as big of a mess as he is, has destroyed her room, and absolutely refuses to help him clear out the mess. But the junk-filled house is only the surface level of the toxicity in this home. Laurie’s ex-fiancé, Billy, also lives in the house! Laurie claims Billy is constantly getting “blackout drunk” and getting in fights with her and her father. Can Dr. Phil get to the root of the dysfunction in this home and start to clean up this mess? Find out!
Video.title: Hoarder Father and His Bug Infested Home!

Video.summary: When these two families first met with Dr. Phil, their lives were in chaos. Have they begun to make changes?
Video.title: Family First: Follow Up

Video.summary: Bill says he believes he is a narcissist after pushing away almost all of his loved ones, including his brother Tom and daughter Bridget, who both stopped speaking to him. After a tense reunion with Tom, Bill gets emotional when Dr. Phil reunites him with Bridget. After violent fights, cruel words, and selfish behavior, will Bill start taking accountability and change?
Video.title: “I Think I'm A Narcissist!"

Video.summary: Dr. Phil continues an intense discussion on negotiated infidelity. Chrissy, a mother of three, says her husband, Scott, refuses to dump his girlfriend and wants her to consider an open relationship. During their first appearance, things got heated when Tracy, Scott’s mistress of five years, came onstage to share her side of the story. Will Scott choose between his lover and his wife, or will both women kick him to the curb? Then, not everyone believes cheating is a bad thing. Holly Hill, author of Sugarbabe, says negotiated infidelity empowers women. She and her boyfriend, Dino, have been in an open relationship for three years, and they say this arrangement helps couples avoid strife and mistrust. What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, see a follow up with Charles, one of Dr. Phil’s most controversial guests, who wanted to explore a polyfidelity lifestyle.
Video.title: Love Triangle Part 2

Video.summary: These moms are sick and tired of living a lie. One mom fears her secret addiction to pain killers will tear her family apart. She asks Dr. Phil to help her get off the drugs before she loses everything, including her unborn child! Also, a grandmother who steals everything from steaks to ceiling fans. She says she knows it’s wrong and wants to stop, but is she really just afraid of getting caught? Plus, a mother confesses to her daughter a secret she has been carrying for 29 years.
Video.title: Mom's Secret Life

Video.summary: Do you hold onto a painful secret from your childhood? Dr. Phil speaks with three sisters torn apart over their painful memories of the past.
Video.title: Childhood Secrets

Video.summary: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. But is that money really being used to fund his addiction? Then, Anthony claims Jamie has another serious issue he needs to address. But the accusation causes Jamie to storm off stage. Don’t miss Part 2 -- will he return and face his problems head-on?
Video.title: My Mooching, Drugging Model Brother (Pt. 1)

Video.summary: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!
Video.title: Cancel Culture Pt 2

Video.summary: A family says their relative is a cult leader who calls herself "Mother God."
Video.title: Cult Leader Mother God

Video.summary: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with a family torn apart. Carole and Bill have been married 19 years and have six daughters. Carole is questioning whether she wants to stay married, and two of their daughters, Kristin and Jenny, accuse her of lying to them about another man in her life. They say their mother has turned into someone they don't recognize, and they're worried about how the family turmoil is affecting their younger sisters. The 18-year-old went into labor without even knowing she was pregnant. Are the two younger girls at risk as well?
Video.title: Affair Intervention

Video.summary: The case of Thomas Cogdell, who confessed to his sister's muder at age 12, is examined.
Video.title: Inside a Murder Confession

Video.summary: When Dr. Phil first met this family, their house was filled with yelling, screaming and name-calling. Dr. Phil checks in to see if Jackie has calmed her raging temper, if Zoli and Derek are speaking to each other and if the kids are following the new house rules.
Video.title: Horvath Check Up

Video.summary: Imagine your weight getting so out of control that it confined you to your home, to a room, even to a bed. Dr. Phil's guests say they feel trapped and isolated in their homes and miss their loved ones.
Video.title: Biggest Reunions

Video.summary: Do you think about everything you eat with the fear of gaining weight? Do you skip meals to lose weight? What about your teenager? Dr. Phil takes an eye-opening journey into the mind of an anorexic and bulimic. Meagan is 26 and weighs only 73 pounds. She starves herself all day, abuses laxatives, and binges and purges at night when everyone is asleep. She's been battling her eating disorders for over 10 years. Her parents, Donna and Tom, fear she could die at any moment and admit they enable Meagan’s disease to keep the peace. Meagan’s sister, Erika, says she’s so disgusted with her sister, she can’t stand being in the same room with her. When one member of the family has an eating disorder, it can make the entire family dysfunctional. Will Meagan accept help, and will her family do the work necessary to support her? Do you know the warning signs of someone who is at risk of developing an eating disorder? Parents, you can’t afford to miss this show!
Video.title: A Family's Fear Part 1

Video.summary: Dr. Phil meets guests who say their perfect day was ruined by everything from booze, to broken down limousines, to grooms from hell, and now their marriages suffer because they can't stop reliving their wedding gone bad.
Video.title: Weddings Gone Bad

Video.summary: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.
Video.title: Hands Off My Teen Daughter

Video.summary: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!
Video.title: My Crazy Family (Part 2)

Video.summary: Dr. Phil's guests say they have a home wrecker in their life who has destroyed their marriage. Lisa says her five-month marriage to Sean is already in a shambles because of his ex-wife, Kristy. Lisa says Kristy makes hateful phone calls, physical threats and frequent attempts to steal Sean away from her. Kristy says she doesn't want Sean back; she just wants him to be a good father to their kids. Then, Sherry says her daughter, Tammy, talked her into divorcing her husband, J.R. Now, Sherry wants to re-marry J.R., but both her daughters are making her choose between them or him. Tammy and her sister say that J.R. controls their mother and they won't support this reunion. Is Sherry making a big mistake, or are her daughters manipulating her? Dr. Phil weighs in on how much influence other people should have in your marriage and your life.
Video.title: Homewreckers

Video.summary: When 24-year-old Andee last met with Dr. Phil, she was struggling with drug addiction -- and her parents, Pam and Ed, blamed each other. After the taping, Andee says she completed 90 days of rehab but later relapsed and is now worse than ever. Is she finally ready to commit to staying clean?
Video.title: Who’s to Blame For Andee’s Relapse?

Video.summary: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.
Video.title: Teacher Suing Student

Video.summary: YouTube sensation “Homeless Joe,” 26, survives on the mean streets of Manhattan by panhandling during the day and picking up women at night. Joe admits he could get a place of his own if he stopped drinking but says being homeless without alcohol is unbearable. Is this “cardboard Casanova” interested in turning his life around?
Video.title: A Handsome And Homeless Romeo

Video.summary: Two moms ask Dr. Phil to give their sons a reality check. Rita says her son, Eric, changed his name to “King Keith” and is forgoing a college education to pursue a singing career. Has he lost touch with reality? And, Cheryl says her college-educated son, Patrick, is lazy and lacks ambition.
Video.title: Spoiled Rotten Sons

Video.summary: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?
Video.title: From Making Millions to Garage Life

Video.summary: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!
Video.title: Role of the Man

Video.summary: Anything goes on “Ask Dr. Phil"! A 25-year-old claims she won’t find happiness until she becomes a millionaire…and would even ditch her loved ones to get it! Is her search for wealth unreasonable? Then, meet one empty nester who cries everyday about her daughter leaving for college—and it’s been four years! Also, you’ll be surprised to find out why one woman wouldn’t pick up the phone, even if her life depended on it!
Video.title: Ask Dr Phil
